title: cNFTcon  - COPI Cafe Special Episode
description:
Join us for our cNFTcon  episode - Lots of special guests and plenty of leaks.

Cornucopias Co-CEO's Rob and Josh welcome Tim Harrison - IOG VP of Community & Ecosystem and Romain Pellerin - IOG CTO to discuss NFT's and Crypto Bison. They are then joined by Damon who has a big Charli3 announcement. Rob and Josh are then joined by Marco - cNFTcon creator to discuss the success of cNFTcon.  Then Scruffy, a community favorite crashes the COPI Cafe stage to chat with guys about why he loves Cornucopias. Last, but not least, Josh flags down David - Derp Birds, to come up on stage to discuss Derp.

Post your contest entries for this episode into the "Word Game" channel in Discord. 

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw 

00:00 - Special cNFTcon Intro
02:42 - Special Guests: Tiim Harrison + Romain Pellerin - IOG
08:30 - Renaming the Show
09:25 - cNFTcon Recap
15:48 - Special Guest: Damon - Charli3
22:40 - Special Guest: Marco - cNFTcon
26:50 - Special Guest: Scruffy - Scruffy Gaming YouTube Channel
32:16 - Special Guest: David - Derp Birds
37:15 - Rob Renames the Show Again
38:00 - Rob + Josh speculate on their Secret Words
39:10 - Rob + Josh Wrap Up the Episode

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK 

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
